# NEVVOH

> Software de gestão de tarefas, projetos e equipes. Kanban, atas de reunião, temporizador Pomodoro e agenda integrada em uma única plataforma.

NEVVOH is a Brazilian-Portuguese (with English support) team productivity platform that combines Kanban task management, team collaboration, meeting minutes, work instructions, idea tracking, a personal calendar, a knowledge base and a Pomodoro focus timer. Pricing is per user/month with a 10-seat minimum and a 14-day free trial.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Landing page with overview of features, how it works, and FAQ.
- [Pricing](/precos): Per-user monthly plans, seat calculator and billing FAQ.
- [Sign in / Sign up](/auth): Authentication for existing and new users.
- [Financial register](/financeiro/cadastro): Registration flow for billing/admin users.
- [Terms of Service](/termos): Legal terms.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacidade): Privacy and data handling policy.
